note: Concession-run (Yellowstone National Park Lodges) campground on the west shore of Yellowstone Lake, just above Bridge Bay Marina and about 2 mi S of Lake Village: open meadow sites in the lower loops, wooded sites in the upper loops. --Claude
summary: NPS + Lodges current. Booking moves to Recreation.gov for 2027 (opens Dec 8, 2026; facility not yet listed on rec.gov - no URL). $38 + taxes 2027 (API $33). 431 sites, RVs to 40 ft (NPS table 60 ft combined), no hookups, flush toilets, dump, no showers/laundry. 2027 season NPS 05-07..09-12 (Lodges 05-21..09-13). Senior/Access 50% applies. Not waterfront kept; lakeview lead. Pin fine. Phone empty -> 307-344-7311.
flags: BOOKING PLATFORM CHANGE: operator -> recreation.gov from the 2027 season (Lodges: 'Reservations for 2027 camping can be made on Recreation.gov starting December 8, 2026'; NPS: 'all campground reservations will be handled through Recreation.gov'). The rec.gov facility is not in rec.gov search yet (Yellowstone recarea lists only the five NPS-run campgrounds), so no booking.url - add it once it appears.

WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' kept; contrary operator claims as a re-audit lead: NPS 'Campers at Bridge Bay will enjoy spectacular views of the lake'; Lodges 'some limited views of the lake' / 'Some sites have a distant view of Yellowstone Lake'. On imagery the nearest loops sit ~175 m from the Yellowstone Lake shore (east loops, Grand Loop Road and a tree band between) and ~225 m from the marina bay (lower loops, marina parking between); the lower meadow loops are open with scattered trees, so a lakeview from some sites is plausible. Not on-water.
max_rig_ft 40 kept (Lodges 'RVs up to 40' long'); the NPS 2027 table gives 60 ft as the RV + vehicle maximum - not used for the rig length.
